description.value: Kin Kao ('eat rice') is an authentic Thai comfort-food restaurant on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, now celebrating nine years in business. Executive chef Tang Phoonchai, a Bangkok native, imports spices directly from Thailand and pairs them with locally sourced ingredients to produce refined street-style and home-cooked Thai dishes. The restaurant's sister spot, SONG, has earned the Michelin Guide Bib Gourmand award two years running, reflecting the quality behind both concepts.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Kin Kao is an active Thai restaurant at 903 Commercial Drive, Vancouver, celebrating 9 years in operation; phone and address match OSM exactly. Takeout is confirmed by OSM takeaway=yes and website takeout section. OSM reservation=no is contradicted by the website ('accepting reservations for groups of 5+'), and OSM opening_hours 17:00-21:30 differs from the website's stated closing time of 10 pm, both flagged as concerns. Menu pages include GF and (V) notations confirming dietary options; no evidence found for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM reservation=no contradicts website, which states 'We are now accepting reservations for groups of 5+'. Website is preferred.
OSM opening_hours tag shows closing at 21:30, but website lists closing time as 10 pm (with last dine-in call at 9:30 pm). Minor discrepancy; website is preferred.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Thai restaurant on Commercial Drive with a functioning website, confirmed contact details, and dine-in, takeout, and delivery options — clearly useful to a touring cyclist seeking a meal.
